equipment.rootCause: CharacterPoseFollower overwrote evaluated body rotation with Animator.bodyRotation, losing the procedural bow yaw. Back bow and quiver had remained attached only to the original gameplay skeleton.
equipment.fix: Retarget evaluated body rotation and align the visible upper-body hand direction while aiming. Fit back equipment to the native torso with stable bind-pose height scaling. Keep held bow grip in the native palm, original gameplay transforms, and weapon LOD selection.
equipment.runtimeMethod: Inspected frozen authored aim poses and idle equipment in an offline Unity Lobby. Temporary diagnostic pose/camera changes were discarded on leaving Play Mode.

coverage: Native bow direction and quiver scale
Local UI binding and cursor modes
